note: walk over the MG then chaingun pickup (GiveWeapon auto-switches to each + grants 6 ammo), fire the chaingun at an SS (rate 4 — fast), switch back to the pistol (key 2, bestweapon stays chaingun) and fire (rate 14), then select the knife (key 1). Exercises the weapon roster: GiveWeapon, per-weapon fire rates, and switching (auto-on-pickup + keys 1/2). A connecting knife hit needs sub-tile range (nx > KNIFEDIST at tile granularity); the out-of-ammo->knife tail of kill_ss/kill_officer covers the KnifeAttack path.
